title: Correct unsupported projected-distance method claims in North Macedonia #995 evidence

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Reviewed scope and dependencies ready for a worker claim

labels.name: type:geography

body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1009, merge `b6cfaada43a1e0472cd833d16733d1fd6065eaec`, head `0c1b0ad47be80ae11f7fc5d1dee0d20a49b9ebd8`; parent #995 (closed).

The retained `data/regional-review/followup-northern-macedonia-422-roster-20261005/SOURCES.md`, line 20, says reproduction transforms to EPSG:3035, establishes a 1 mm Hausdorff limit, and emits observed maxima in `crosswalk-results.json`. The committed `reproduce.py` instead transforms EPSG:4258 to EPSG:4326 with longitude first, computes WGS84 ellipsoidal symmetric-difference area fractions using the shared helper, and emits only that area maximum. It contains no EPSG:3035 transformation, Hausdorff calculation or distance maximum. `REVIEW.md` describes the ellipsoidal method. Thus the retained reproducible evidence does not substantiate the claimed distance measurement or projected method. This does not establish that a distance would exceed 1 mm, that no historical manual computation occurred, or that the retained area value is wrong.

Actual isolated verification: two complete offline comparisons using the original shapefile decoder and shared area helper reproduced all 84 pairs and the reported maximum fraction `8.050588843771585e-12`; fresh outputs were byte-identical, SHA256 `d1d33aaa0653a8f324a7e5eee05e2ebbc2aa3da7c73f26e8ff4587b81887daec`. Every pair had a positive residual: zero exact-equal geometries, 84 within the explicitly declared `1e-8` screen. All 24 archive members were CRC checked, 387,976 total decoded bytes. Four packet controls reproduced their original bytes; eight scientific/preparation tests and 24 evidence-quality/premerge tests passed. This confirms the area screen, not a Hausdorff result or geographic approval.

Reproduce the documentation defect from the immutable merge without network or running the historical main: inspect SOURCES.md line 20, the `source_to_wgs84` and `hdx_vs_geoboundaries` loop in reproduce.py, and the keys of `retained_hdx_source_archive` in crosswalk-results.json. Compare the documented measurement/outputs with the actual code and fields. The original main accesses an unretained AKN response and overwrites the historical output; do not execute it unmodified or substitute fabricated official geometry.

Expected: every method/measurement claim must identify the actual CRS, coordinate order, mathematical interpretation, tolerance and corresponding retained output. An unperformed distance measurement must be explicitly unsupported; a newly added one needs its own dated, reproducible evidence rather than retroactively attributing it to the historical run.

Bounded source-only correction, at most two PRs, owned exclusively under `data/regional-review/northern-macedonia-method-995-erratum/`:

- Add a versioned erratum correcting the method provenance, with exact original file/merge/hash links. Preserve the old packet, historical dates/results, all sources, Atlas IDs, and shared code/geography unchanged.
- Add a fully offline, whole-input-pinned comparison for the retained HDX/geoBoundaries phase, rejecting wrong input/code bytes and existing output, with two distinct exclusive outputs and meaningful positive/negative controls. Use the 30 actual whole-input descriptors below, exact 84 native subjects, and eight parent contexts as references only. Separate full-precision source comparison from stored Atlas geometry: all 84 stored geometry objects differ, some with reduced vertices; source overlaps do not prove stored Atlas boundary equivalence.
- Document the exact nonzero residuals/tolerance and actual metric fields. Either remove unsupported EPSG:3035/Hausdorff attribution in the erratum or supply separately dated reproducible distance evidence and a declared CRS/units. Do not invent or relabel historical results. Obtain substantive independent exact-head source/implementation and applicable geometry review.

Success: new erratum explains the mismatch and actual method; all 84 source pairs accounted for exactly once; complete immutable inputs and fresh outputs verified; two deterministic retained-phase runs with meaningful rejection controls; old bytes remain unchanged; all quantities map to actual emitted fields. Recalculate complete-phase admission within 32 MiB per ordinary/decoded object, 256 MiB per complete phase and 512 descriptors. Auditor retained-phase admission: 20,430,279 ordinary whole-input bytes + 387,976 decoded archive bytes + 2,097,152 output reserve = 22,915,407 bytes. No streaming/chunking/extraction workaround for an oversized original.

Readiness reviewed: complete open/closed issue pagination (11 full pages of 100 plus 65) found only closed #995 and its merged PR addressing this packet; no method erratum. Complete open-PR pagination and reviewed issue scopes found no owner of this new path. #995 is closed with its canonical author claim released; no claim is taken or altered. This issue is limited to independently available retained evidence. Existing #1159 covers broader #994 primary-source shortcomings and is not duplicated. Official source restoration is outside this issue and is not a readiness dependency.

Limits: the AKN exact response, SSO primary source bodies/workbook transcription, official roster authority/vintages and license conclusions are not independently verified by these retained-phase checks. Source/target overlap and target-coverage values only passed internal roster/ranking/summary checks here, not a rerun using authentic AKN geometry. Missing required verification keeps the original PR audit Incomplete. This issue authorizes no legal boundary assertion, regional/parent approval, live edits, imports or deployment.
